sentences.en: The notorious dictator abused his privileges to his heart's content.
sentences.zh: 这个臭名昭著的独裁者尽情地滥用他的特权。

sentences.en: The popularity of a web site depends on its content.
sentences.zh: 一个网站的受欢迎程度取决于它的内容。

sentences.en: Today you can't be content with just earning a living.
sentences.zh: 如今你不能仅仅满足于谋生。
